findings: Original Unique compacts entries but returns based on original loop index rather than compacted count; three equal triangles produce two, confirmed.
Triangles.Less fails to stop at first unequal vertex when comparison should returnfalse; finite sorted-vertex control has Less(a,b)=Less(b,a)=true, violating strict ordering.

ExtractEquilateralTriangleFrom constructs forward B*inverse(A), then uses it to sample destination points in source; shifted opaque-source control yields transparent interior. No original end-to-end extraction test exists.
Original matrix tests check algebraic arrays, determinant/cofactor and matrix-vector products but not rendered extraction. Rotation test checks only matrix multiplication, not pixel permutation.

AllPossibilities uses signed integer-truncated area before sorting vertices; negative winding is filtered when MinArea>=0, degenerate line triangles admitted at defaultMinArea0. Source observation, no separate winding control.
Possibilities expected results call production Unique, so shared deduplication defect may affect both actual and expected.

Triangle inverse has no singularity error; zero determinant skips normalization. Matrix.TransformPoint ignores homogeneous z. These are source observations, not independently executed projective/singular controls.
